Title: PROJECT HYPERION: 2180 - EPISODE 1: THE GANYMEDE BREACH
Credit: Written by Screenplay Vault
Author: CanonGuard Franchise Archives
Draft date: 2175 A.D.

INT. GANYMEDE SUB-SURFACE DOCK 4 - NIGHT - 2175

Red emergency sirens strobe across the massive titanium bulkheads. Decompression klaxons wail.

CHIEF ENGINEER MARCUS VANCE (37), soot smeared across his EVA suit, frantically types override codes into the primary console.

Beside him stands DR. ARIS THORNE (Model AX-9), synthetic chrome skin reflecting the pulsing crimson warning indicators.

DR. ARIS THORNE
Antimatter magnetic field containment is decaying at 4.2 percent per second. The Hyperion Drive has entered runaway resonance!

CHIEF ENGINEER MARCUS VANCE
Eject the core into the Jovian gravity well! We cannot let another disaster happen like Phobos in 2172!

DR. ARIS THORNE
Admiral Teresa Cruz went down with Phobos Station when her hull breached. If this core detonates inside Dock 4, all twelve thousand colonists will follow her to the grave!

Vance pulls the manual emergency jettison lever. Sparks burst from the hydraulic couplings.

The blast doors shudder. Inside the containment chamber, the HYPERION DARK-MATTER DRIVE flares into a blinding sapphire vortex.

DR. ARIS THORNE (CONT'D)
Containment failure is absolute. The core is undergoing subatomic vaporization!

A deafening shockwave rocks the station. The sapphire vortex collapses into a blinding pinprick, consuming the entire drive array.

When the smoke clears, only a scorched, empty magnetic cradle remains. The Hyperion Dark-Matter Drive has been completely vaporized.

CHIEF ENGINEER MARCUS VANCE
(coughing into his respirator)
The drive... the prototype drive is completely destroyed. Record it in the naval archives. Year 2175. The Hyperion program is dead.

Title: PROJECT HYPERION: 2180 - EPISODE 2: COLD SLEEP TRANSIT
Credit: Written by Screenplay Vault
Author: CanonGuard Franchise Archives
Draft date: 2178 A.D.

INT. USC BOREALIS - CRYOGENIC BAY - 2178

The steady, rhythmic hum of liquid helium pumps fills the silent chamber. Rows of frosted cylindrical pods line the dark corridor.

DR. ARIS THORNE (Model AX-9) steps silently along the catwalk, checking biometric readouts on a handheld diagnostic pad.

Thorne stops before POD 09. Through the condensation-frosted quartz glass, the frozen face of SPECIAL AGENT GABRIEL CROSS (33) is visible. His eyelids are sealed behind a silver retinal sheath.

A digital holographic readout hovers over the pod:
SUBJECT: SPECIAL AGENT GABRIEL CROSS
STATUS: DEEP CRYOGENIC SUSPENSION (COMMENCED 2165)
AUTOMATED REVIVAL SCHEDULED: 2190 A.D.
CURRENT TRANSIT TIME: 13 YEARS ELAPSED / 12 YEARS REMAINING

DR. ARIS THORNE
(recording audio log)
Ship Log: Stardate 2178. Dr. Thorne reporting. USC Borealis has crossed the Saturn orbital boundary on conventional ion cruise.

Thorne taps the stasis pod status panel.

DR. ARIS THORNE (CONT'D)
Agent Cross remains in stable deep-freeze stasis within Pod 09. Core temperature negative two-hundred-fourteen Celsius. Neural engrams fully frozen. No waking consciousness will occur until the year 2190.

lore_rules.rule_statement: Antimatter magnetic field containment can decay, leading to runaway resonance and core detonation.
Jovian gravity wells can be used as a viable method for safely ejecting unstable energy cores.
The Hyperion Dark-Matter Drive operates with subatomic vaporization during runaway resonance, resulting in complete destruction if containment fails.

Deep Cryogenic Suspension can preserve human life for decades (e.g., 25+ years) by freezing neural engrams and core temperature to extreme sub-zero levels, preventing waking consciousness until automated revival.
